{
  "name": "agentic-ops",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "private": true,
  "engines": { "node": "24.x" },
  "scripts": {
    "dev": "next dev",
    "build": "next build",
    "start": "next start",
    "lint": "eslint .",
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "verify:client-secrets": "node scripts/verify-client-secrets.mjs",
    "verify:env": "tsx --conditions=react-server scripts/verify-env.ts",
    "test": "tsx --conditions=react-server --test src/server/state/workflow.test.ts src/server/agents/planner.test.ts src/server/agents/orchestrator.test.ts src/server/agents/openai-planner-provider.test.ts src/server/agents/research.test.ts src/server/agents/research-execution.test.ts src/server/agents/research-providers.test.ts src/server/agents/outreach.test.ts src/server/agents/outreach-execution.test.ts src/lib/validation/supabase-env.test.ts src/lib/workspace-view.test.ts src/server/execution/contracts.test.ts src/server/execution/executor.test.ts src/server/integrations/providers.test.ts src/server/integrations/oauth.test.ts src/server/http/mutations.test.ts src/server/automation/automation.test.ts src/server/integrations/gmail-monitor.test.ts src/server/observability/observability.test.ts src/server/observability/runtime-telemetry.test.ts src/server/automation/completion-recovery.test.ts src/server/automation/health-recovery.test.ts src/server/automation/reply-scheduler.test.ts src/server/automation/followup-actor.test.ts src/server/analytics/analytics.test.ts src/server/services/strategy.test.ts src/lib/prospect-filters.test.ts src/lib/workflow-defaults.test.ts src/lib/demo-fixture.test.ts src/server/repositories/security-boundaries.test.ts src/components/workflow-detail/pipeline-state.test.ts src/server/config/env.test.ts",
    "verify:research": "tsx --conditions=react-server scripts/verify-research.ts",
    "verify:outreach": "tsx --conditions=react-server scripts/verify-outreach.ts",
    "verify:execution": "tsx --conditions=react-server scripts/verify-execution.ts",
    "automation:dev": "npx trigger.dev@4.7.0 dev --env-file .env.local",
    "automation:deploy": "npx trigger.dev@4.7.0 deploy",
    "test:e2e": "playwright test",
    "verify:source-secrets": "node scripts/verify-source-secrets.mjs",
    "report:client-bundles": "node scripts/report-client-bundles.mjs"
  },
  "dependencies": {
    "@base-ui/react": "^1.8.0",
    "@supabase/ssr": "0.12.0",
    "@supabase/supabase-js": "2.108.0",
    "@trigger.dev/sdk": "^4.7.0",
    "class-variance-authority": "^0.7.1",
    "cn": "^0.4.0",
    "lucide-react": "^0.468.0",
    "motion": "^13.4.4",
    "next": "16.3.6",
    "nodemailer": "^10.0.13",
    "openai": "^6.49.0",
    "react": "19.3.0",
    "react-dom": "19.3.0",
    "server-only": "^0.0.1",
    "tw-animate-css": "^1.4.0",
    "ws": "^8.22.0",
    "zod": "^4.0.0"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@playwright/test": "^1.63.0",
    "@tailwindcss/postcss": "^4.3.3",
    "@types/node": "^20.0.0",
    "@types/nodemailer": "^8.0.2",
    "@types/react": "^19.0.0",
    "@types/react-dom": "^19.0.0",
    "@types/ws": "^8.18.2",
    "eslint": "^9.0.0",
    "eslint-config-next": "16.3.6",
    "shadcn": "^4.21.0",
    "tailwindcss": "^4.3.3",
    "tsx": "^4.23.15",
    "typescript": "^5.0.0"
  },
  "overrides": {
    "ws": "^8.22.0"
  }
}
